criteria.criterion: A slug that does exist still works while unknown ones 404: `GET /:slug` redirects with 302 and `GET /links/:slug` returns 200 — the 404 is for misses only, not a blanket response.
criteria.evidence: T5.log verify script posts a known slug then asserts 302 on GET /:known and 200 on GET /links/:known before probing unknown slugs; gate log shows no GATE FAIL. Confirmed by reading src/links/links.service.ts:36-42 and redirect.controller.ts — redirect() only throws when repository.incrementHits returns undefined.

criteria.criterion: `GET /nope99` returns 404 with no `Location` header and no redirect.
criteria.evidence: links.service.ts:36-42 throws NotFoundException before the @Redirect() decorator's return value is used; Nest's exception filter runs ahead of the redirect pipeline, so no Location header is set. Verify script's redirect:'manual' fetch would report a non-404 status if a redirect occurred, and the gate passed.
links.service.ts:28-34 findBySlug throws NotFoundException when repository.findBySlug returns undefined; links.controller.ts:15-18 has no try/catch to swallow it.

criteria.criterion: A well-formed but unknown slug such as `aaaaaa` behaves the same on both routes.
criteria.evidence: Verify script loops over ['nope99','aaaaaa'] applying identical assertions to both routes; both are looked up via the same repository methods with no special-casing by slug shape.

criteria.criterion: The 404 response body is JSON containing a human-readable `message`.
criteria.evidence: NotFoundException(`No link found for slug "${slug}"`) produces Nest's default JSON body {statusCode,message,error}; verify script asserts lj.message is a string for the /links/:slug 404.

criteria.criterion: Looking up unknown slugs creates no rows in the `links` table.
criteria.evidence: links.repository.ts:41-44 incrementHits runs an UPDATE ... WHERE slug = ? (no-op on 0 matching rows) then a SELECT, never an INSERT; verify script asserts the links table holds exactly 1 row (the one created during setup) after probing two unknown slugs.
